run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways to transform string a into string b by removing characters
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input pairs to verify subsequence counting correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that counts subsequence matches between two strings
review_f_gold: review the f_gold DP table approach for counting ways to form string b from string a
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(m*n) to O(n) using a 1D DP array
